derived.method: 231,924,793 Blackstone Holdings Partnership Units / (729,415,925 shares of common stock outstanding + 439,589,683 Blackstone Holdings Partnership Units owned by limited partners, both as of February 21, 2025) = 19.84%. Computed, not stated in the filing. Basis: Blackstone Inc. common stock plus the partnership units of Blackstone Holdings held by its limited partners (Blackstone personnel and others), which are exchangeable for common stock one-for-one; together these are the whole economic interest in Blackstone Holdings. Caveats: the 10-K's own '51.8% of class' for his units implies a larger unit denominator (about 448 million, probably including unvested units) than the 439,589,683 units it reports as outstanding, and the 10-K does not state that denominator; using its year-end total of 1,221,159,186 vested and unvested shares and units (December 31, 2024) instead would give about 19.0%.

The Series II preferred stockholder, Blackstone Group Management L.L.C. notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2024'). Blackstone files no DEF 14A; ownership is from Item 12 of the FY2024 Form 10-K (filed February 28, 2025), as of February 21, 2025. BASIS: Mr. Schwarzman owns no Blackstone Inc. common stock, so his share of the listed common stock alone is 0%. His economic interest is in Blackstone Holdings partnership units, which share in Blackstone's earnings alongside the common stock and can be exchanged for it one-for-one. The record therefore uses a derived figure of 19.84% of common stock plus limited partners' units (see derived.method; about 19.0% on the year-end vested-plus-unvested count). The units he holds include 3,686,266 units in family trusts for which he is investment trustee (beneficial ownership disclaimed) and 1,438,529 units held by a separate entity he controls; he also holds a further 364,278 units in each of Blackstone Holdings II, III and IV L.P., and the table excludes units held by his children or family trusts over which he has no control. pctVoting is null because the filing gives no personal voting percentage: the 38.5% Series I vote belongs to Blackstone Partners L.L.C., which he controls, and board elections are controlled by the Series II preferred stockholder, which he also controls. HOLDERS: left empty because the only other 5% holders the 10-K lists, The Vanguard Group (8.6%, based on a Schedule 13G/A reporting holdings as of December 29, 2023: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1393818/000110465924020021/tv0029-blackstoneinc.htm) and BlackRock (6.3%, Schedule 13G as of December 31, 2023: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1393818/000108636424005138/us09260d1072_012924.txt), are measured as % of common stock only, a different basis from the leader's derived figure, and may not be converted. Jonathan D. Gray holds 41,293,901 units (9.2% of units). DIVIDENDS: $2,629.2m of capital distributions to Blackstone Inc. common stockholders in 2024, from the equity statement. The cash-flow line 'Dividends/Distributions to Stockholders and Unitholders' is $4,424.2m (tagged us-gaap:PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock in XBRL) and also includes distributions to Blackstone Holdings unitholders, which are non-controlling interests ($1,806.6m in the equity statement), so it is not used. On the derived ownership basis, which includes the units, about $4.42 billion went to stockholders and unitholders together. BUYBACKS: $520.4m of common stock repurchases. The cash-flow line 'Net Settlement of Vested Common Stock and Repurchase of Common Stock' ($661.1m) also includes net settlement of vested awards. STOCK COMP: matches Note 16, which reports compensation expense of $1.2 billion for equity-based awards. PLAN: null; no broad employee stock purchase plan is described in the 10-K. GEOGRAPHY: null because Note 19 gives only percentages of total GAAP revenues by region, attributed by the geography of investments held: Americas 76%, Europe, Middle East and Africa 16%, Asia-Pacific 8% (2024). It also says domestically generated revenues were 68% of total GAAP revenues. Total revenues were $13,229,968 thousand. No dollar amounts by region are given, so none are derived.
